properties.displayName: [Baseline] Resource groups should carry the required tag
properties.description: Denies creation of resource groups that lack the required tag (default: CostCenter). Enforcing the tag at the resource group level, combined with the companion tag-inheritance policy, guarantees every resource in the estate is attributable for cost allocation and ownership without taxing every individual deployment.

metadata.description: The effect the policy applies when a resource group lacks the required tag.
The tag that every resource group must carry.
